empirical_scope: Real GDP, United States, calendar 2024 Q1. Three archived headline growth estimates only. Not current GDP and not a fitted nowcast.
unit: Percent change from preceding quarter, seasonally adjusted annual rate

estimate_stages.3: third within this extract; not final truth

release_time_evidence: Three source headers say 08:30 EDT; timestamps converted to UTC. See gdp-source-receipts.json.
availability_assumption: Provider publication plus a specified constant collection delay, 0, 60 or 3600 seconds. This reconstructed archive does not establish actual historical ingestion times. Equality at the availability boundary is eligible.
snapshot_key: period and release_utc unique; most recent eligible release per period; duplicate keys rejected
no_record: Missing, not zero. No future backfill.

controlled_inputs.controlled-release-ledger.csv: Six authored monthly index records. Unit: index points. Forecast: mean of available January/February latest records for March. March target first=5, later=7. No empirical economic process fitted.
controlled_inputs.information-worlds.csv: Four equally weighted possibilities; Y=0,2,4,6, coarse signal=0,0,1,1. Unit: abstract outcome units.

extraction: Three numerical values transcribed from the opening real-GDP headlines and cross-checked against raw PDF first pages. The three-stage comparison was inspected in the third release. No source pages or logos bundled.

rights.bea_extract: BEA information is public domain unless stated otherwise; https://www.bea.gov/help/faq/147. Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.

rights.alfred: Documentation linked only; no ALFRED dataset or images bundled.

case_status: C02 release-ledger prerequisite implemented; larger real-time nowcast and latent-state case remains planned.
